source_grounding_result: build_feedback binds locators through cache_v3.source_snapshot, so only currently admitted files and existing inclusive line ranges are accepted. content_digest is sha256 of selected lines joined by newline, matching MemoryLedger._source_evidence_digest; append_event therefore marks source evidence locally verified. Drift of the bound lines or the whole file reports stale; restoring the bound bytes returns current. Non-admitted, missing, excluded, traversal and out-of-range locators are refused with stable reason codes.
privacy_result: normalize_query and note/reason/reviewer validators call security.scan_text and refuse with query_privacy_refused, note_privacy_refused, reason_privacy_refused or reviewer_privacy_refused. FeedbackError never interpolates the rejected value. Independent canary probes found no echo in exception text, traceback, subject, or feedback_report. Invalid records null the query. Owned source, tests and docs have zero scan_bytes findings.
retrieval_quality_result: retrieve_sources remains byte-identical with and without feedback events. Feedback payloads always set retrieval_influence false. Production context does not: assemble_context and build_capsule change once a matching durable feedback fact exists, because ledger.recall indexes payload query terms. That fails the assigned no-influence / byte-identical-context gate and the task-card exclusion that context stay byte-identical.
